claims.assertion: Mari says people choose Earth’s challenges for learning; extracting someone may interrupt their life plan and lead to a harder repeated incarnation.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She advises checking whether someone is fleeing a problem and waiting years to assess whether extraction fits their life plan; hardship alone is insufficient.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She allows exceptions when clearly necessary.

claims.assertion: Mari says extraction permanently ends return to Earth, requiring major adaptation and careful review of the person’s needs, attachments, and resources.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She compares it to ending an incarnation.
